0x003317.en: 「Defense wins the unwinnable,/ offense wins the winnable.」

0x003361.en: 「Feel the power of the Fire Masou Kishin firsthand.」

0x00339E.en: 「If you stand in my way, I show no mercy!」

0x00343B.en: 「Yes, strike first and seize control./ Even more so with Granveil's power.」

0x0034AC.en: 「A shame, General Kirkus./ I believed in your honor.../ and you betrayed it.」

0x00352D.en: 「General, you took the wrong path!/ As a Masou Kishin pilot.../ I will defeat you!」

0x0035AB.en: 「General, you've become a traitor.../ Then I must strike you down!」

0x003604.en: 「Hmph... let your emotions run wild/ and you'll never master a Masouki.」

0x003663.en: 「You've got interesting spirit.../ but you're still very rough.」

0x0036B3.en: 「So emotional... a hard woman to control.」

0x0036F3.en: 「Enough, out of my way!/ I've no time to waste on you!」

0x00379C.en: 「I've no time to deal with him.../ You're persistent, Louzorl!」

0x00381A.en: 「We're even now./ I'll defeat you without holding back,/ Saphine!」

0x003889.en: 「I don't know what you're plotting,/ but it's surely no good./ I'll stop you now, Saphine.」

0x00391F.en: 「Tell me honestly what you're plotting./ Depending on the answer, I might let you go.」

0x003993.en: 「Ho, quite the skilled one./ But it was your bad luck to face me.」

0x003A04.en: 「That movement... no mere small fry./ I'd best stay wary.」

0x003A60.en: 「I see, you've got some skill./ No room for carelessness.」

0x003AAD.en: 「Women and servants are hard to handle...!」

0x003AE4.en: 「I've no time to play with children!」

0x003B18.en: 「That malice, I'll sweep it away/ with the power of Granveil!」

0x003BA5.en: 「They say great skill seems clumsy.../ but that doesn't apply to you.」

0x003C10.en: 「Against a tough foe, striking first is best.」

0x003C4D.en: 「Truly not a foe to take lightly.」

0x003C7B.en: 「First strike wins. I won't miss this chance.」

0x003D05.en: 「Don't envy the immortals... man should live out/ the lifespan he's given!」

0x003D64.en: 「A strong foe. Stay on your guard.」

0x003DB1.en: 「Son Ganglong, your ravings won't sway me!」

0x003E0A.en: 「A guest to be met with cold eyes.」

0x003E38.en: 「Whatever cause you claim,/　you've no right to trample the Earth!」

0x003E9A.en: 「A comeback, is it?/　But while we stand, it will all come to nothing!」

0x003F08.en: 「Melior Esse... no foe to relax against.」

0x003F45.en: 「A different aura, but I won't flinch!」

0x003FB9.en: 「War is deception, but you're beyond the pale!」

0x003FFC.en: 「Gaia Sabers,/ you have no cause left!」

0x0040A2.en: 「Volkruss...?/　Indeed, a foe I can't ignore.」

0x0040EC.en: 「Such an abnormal mass of negative aura.../　So this is the thing/　that threatens La Gias...」

0x00417F.en: 「What a sinister monster./　I can't leave it be./　I'll lay it to rest.」

0x0041EB.en: 「Numbers alone win no war./　Don't think mere numbers can stop me.」

0x004250.en: 「Those who obey heaven live, those who defy it fall./　Gan Eden, that applies to you as well!」

0x0042D0.en: 「I'll fell the false god fooling men!」

0x0042FB.en: 「Pride goes before a fall.../　No, you'll never reach your glory!」

0x00434E.en: 「I speak not of monsters and spirits,/　but if it harms men, then!」

0x0043CC.en: 「Even the Four Gods, if they harm men,/　are no auspicious beasts.」

0x004422.en: 「A tiger with wings, they say, but you can't stop me!」

0x00467E.en: 「Kh!! To think they had this much power...」

0x004714.en: 「Guh! N-no good!/　Did I take too much damage...」

0x0047F4.en: 「Yes, I am./　But Granveil's in bad shape.」

0x0048B5.en: 「Guh!!/　A-as I thought, no easy foe.」

0x004902.en: 「Nngh! So this is a hermit's skill!」

0x00493C.en: 「Yang Long... no ordinary man after all!」

0x0049B6.en: 「Guh! I can't let that loose on the world!」

0x0049F9.en: 「Guh! This power... I can't ignore it!」

0x004A70.en: 「Guh!!/　I don't want to believe I misjudged her, but.../　Saphine's power is truly this much...」

0x004AEE.en: 「What?!/　Pushed back by Princess Monica.../　how can this be.」

0x004B48.en: 「Ngh,/ you tuned the Browel up this far!」

0x004B98.en: 「So those battle records weren't/　just for show...!」

0x004BEB.en: 「Tch!!/　To hold power this great.../　I didn't expect it!」

0x004C45.en: 「N-no good.../　I shouldn't keep tangling with this thing.」

0x004C9E.en: 「Pushed back... by a monster like that!」

0x004CDB.en: 「As I thought, it brings no good omen...!」

0x004D1E.en: 「Guh, you really live up to the name Four Fiends!」

0x004D8C.en: 「Ngh! I refuse to be swallowed by that delusion!」

0x004DCC.en: 「Kh,/　worthy of calling itself a god...!」

0x004E59.en: 「A thing like that... the new progenitor!?」

0x004F52.en: 「Ngh!! But if it's only this much!!」

0x004F8C.en: 「Not bad... but/　don't get cocky over just that!!」

0x004FDC.en: 「Kh... better than I thought./　But I can still go!」

0x005026.en: 「Kh... a direct hit!/　But not yet!」

0x00510D.en: 「Hm... but Granveil/　won't fall to just this!」

0x005166.en: 「I see.../　You do back up your big talk,/　General Kirkus.」

0x0051F4.en: 「Kh.../　going toe-to-toe with you/　is pointless, and yet here I am!」

0x005257.en: 「Ho... a clean hit on me/　...Princess Monica.」

0x0052E7.en: 「Tch, a direct hit./　You've got some skill, Saphine.」

0x0053C1.en: 「It won't work! Not at that level!」

0x0054BE.en: 「Did you really think an attack like that/　could match me!」

0x005555.en: 「Did you really think an attack like that/　would work on Granveil!」

0x005619.en: 「What's wrong, Saphine! Are you having fun!」

0x00565C.en: 「...Princess Monica,/　you're no match for me.」

0x0056B2.en: 「You were never a match for Granveil,/　General Kirkus!」

0x00571A.en: 「Feeble... just a mantis against a wheel」

0x005792.en: 「Ho, a hit. But that's your limit.」

0x0057E8.en: 「Taihoku, far too weak to drive me back!」

0x00583B.en: 「Are you mocking me,/　or is that truly all you've got?/　Volkruss.」

0x005979.en: 「Too slow! Not with moves like that!」

0x005A36.en: 「Fight this many times and/　I can read your moves.」

0x005B2E.en: 「No matter how you tune it,/　the Browel has its limits!」

0x005B84.en: 「Great power... but only if it lands!」

0x005BE9.en: 「Hmph... all that big talk, and this is all you've got.」

0x005CAA.en: 「Is that all the Melior Esse can do?」

0x005DA0.en: 「Is that the power of the Four Gods?」

0x005DCB.en: 「The Four Fiends' curse won't reach me!」

0x005EC0.en: 「Fast, Duraxil.../　but not too fast to dodge!」

0x005F1C.en: 「Fast, yes... but not too fast to read.」

0x005F5C.en: 「Ohryu, lord of the Four Dragons? This?」

0x005F99.en: 「All bark and no bite, it seems.」

0x00600E.en: 「An attack from out of range... nice.」

0x006095.en: 「I won't let you off so easy!」

0x00616C.en: 「Right, leave the finish to me, Masaki!」

0x006264.en: 「Missed the kill, Lune./ Guess I'll have to help you.」

0x0062BA.en: 「Helping you... well, I suppose it's fine for now.」

0x0067BB.en: 「Yes, even at the cost of my life!」

0x006802.en: 「When fire burns the mount, jade and stone alike...」

0x006909.en: 「Rin pyo to sha kai jin retsu zen...go!!」
